statement: A third mute_button_led mode, pulsing, is likely: SDL documents value 0x02 as pulse and VIIPER names an Off/On/Breathing mode set. Only SDL gives the numeric value, and neither source shows a physical observation.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, VIIPER a370903, nondebug 0233835; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_ps5.c 742 (comment: 0x00 off, 0x01 solid, 0x02 pulse; SDL itself sends 0); VIIPER dualsense.md 103-107 (mode names, no values). Linux never sends a value above 1. Needs a physical LED-only check.
